items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, that's Louie, and then Johnny Dodds and Baby Dodds. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Look, one of them married Paul's sister, one of them Dodds married Paul's sister.
